collections.title: SF Masterworks — the relaunch
collections.intro: In 2010 Gollancz gave the SF Masterworks a new face: the numbers went, the series name turned sideways and climbed the left edge of the cover, and the list kept growing — past the classics of the first run to newer books that had earned the name. This wall holds 182 of them in the order of the list, each in its relaunch design. Where ISFDB names the cover artist, the name is under the tile.
